CatalogEntryRequest.description: Payload for creating or updating a custom permission catalog entry.

key.description: Ignored on update because the permissionKey path parameter is authoritative.

CatalogEntryResponse.description: Permission catalog entry exposed to administrators.

EffectiveGrantResponse.description: Effective allow or deny grant and its origin.

EffectivePermissionResponse.description: Complete effective permission evaluation for a player.

EffectiveRoleAssignmentResponse.description: Role assignment that contributed to effective permissions.

GlobalPermissionSnapshot.description: Transferable global permission snapshot. Player-specific grant arrays must be absent or empty.

GrantRequest.description: Payload for creating or updating a permission grant. scopeValue must be absent for GLOBAL and is required for all other scopes.

scopeValue.description: Absent for GLOBAL; a nonblank value is required for other scope kinds.

Instant.description: ISO-8601 timestamp with a UTC offset.

JsonNode.description: Arbitrary JSON value stored as audit metadata.

JsonNodeType.description: Category of an arbitrary JSON value.

KeycloakGroupMappingRequest.description: Payload for mapping a Keycloak group to a permission role.

KeycloakGroupMappingResponse.description: Mapping from a Keycloak group to a permission role.

PagedResponse.description: Paginated result page with total matching records.

PagedResponseCatalogEntryResponse.description: Paginated result page with total matching records.

PagedResponseEffectiveGrantResponse.description: Paginated result page with total matching records.

PagedResponseKeycloakGroupMappingRespons.description: Paginated result page with total matching records.

PagedResponsePlayerEffectiveRoleResponse.description: Paginated result page with total matching records.

PagedResponsePlayerGrantResponse.description: Paginated result page with total matching records.

PagedResponseRoleGrantResponse.description: Paginated result page with total matching records.

PermissionAuditEventResponse.description: One immutable permission administration audit event.

PermissionCheckResponse.description: Decision for a single player permission check.

PermissionEffect.description: Whether a permission grant allows or denies access.

PermissionGrantOriginKind.description: Origin of a role assignment or effective permission grant.

PermissionGrantSource.description: Policy source that produced an effective runtime permission grant.

PermissionProjectSnapshot.description: Current project permission state used for environment comparison.

PermissionScopeDto.description: Scope that limits where a runtime permission grant applies.

PermissionScopeKind.description: Scope dimension in which a permission grant applies.

PermissionSyncAction.description: Selected resolution for one environment-sync entity change.

PermissionSyncDiff.description: Calculated differences between project and global permission state.

PermissionSyncImportRequest.description: Environment import request. Each entityType and technicalKey pair must be unique, and every action must match the previewed change and its allowed resolution.

PermissionSyncMetadataRecord.description: Metadata recorded after a permission environment import.

PermissionSyncPreviewResponse.description: Preview of permission changes produced by an environment snapshot.

PlayerEffectiveRoleResponse.description: Effective player role and the assignments that contributed it.

PlayerGrantResponse.description: Direct permission grant assigned to a player.

PlayerIdentityResponse.description: Projected Minecraft identity and evaluation readiness for a player.

PlayerRoleGrantRequest.description: Payload for assigning a role directly to a player.

PlayerRoleGrantResponse.description: Direct role assignment for a player.

PlayerSearchItemResponse.description: Player search result with permission assignment counts.

RoleGrantResponse.description: Permission grant assigned to a role.

RoleListResponse.description: Permission role summary with aggregate assignment counts.

RoleRequest.description: Payload for creating or updating a permission role.

RuntimeManifestPermissionRequest.description: Permission catalog entry contained in a runtime manifest.

RuntimeManifestRequest.description: Complete permission catalog manifest published by one runtime source; an empty permissions list clears the source, permission keys must be unique, and source must not appear in the body.

RuntimePermissionSnapshotResponse.description: Effective permission snapshot consumed by a runtime workload.

RuntimeRoleMetadataDto.description: Display metadata for an effective runtime role.

SyncAction.description: Resolution action applied to an environment-sync change.

SyncCatalogEntry.description: Permission catalog entry contained in an environment snapshot.

SyncChange.description: One permission entity difference in an environment-sync preview.

SyncChangeKind.description: Kind of difference between target and imported permission state.

SyncDispatchResponse.description: Acknowledgement for an asynchronously dispatched synchronization.

SyncEntityType.description: Permission entity category used by environment synchronization.

SyncInheritance.description: Parent-child role inheritance edge contained in an environment snapshot.

SyncKeycloakMapping.description: Keycloak group-to-role mapping contained in an environment snapshot.

SyncPlayerGrant.description: Rejected player-specific grant marker in a global environment snapshot.

SyncRole.description: Permission role contained in an environment snapshot.

SyncRoleGrant.description: Role permission grant contained in an environment snapshot.
